scope_note: Released feature-film acting appearances through 13 September 2026 (97 films), including cameos, special and song appearances, self appearances, narration and voice-over. Excluded: television series and hosting; music videos; the short film Bhaag Jeetu Bhaag (2016); producer-only credits; and King, scheduled for 24 December 2026 and unreleased at the cutoff. Release dates are Indian theatrical dates, with festival premieres noted. Box-office figures are Wikipedia citations of trade sources, mostly Box Office India, and are graded accordingly; figures without a nett/gross label are kept in research notes rather than money columns. Collaborators covers directors, producers or banners, composers and key writers on at least two of his films, plus directors of historically significant single collaborations. Awards covers Filmfare and National Film Award wins for his non-cameo films, all of Khan's own Filmfare nominations, his wins at other film ceremonies (television-hosting awards excluded), Filmfare Awards South wins for Hey Ram, and civilian and state honours. Three award rows lack a ceremony year because the fetched sources do not give one.

career_phases.summary: After television work, he debuts in Deewana as an ardent young lover and plays romantic leads in Raju Ban Gaya Gentleman and Dil Aashna Hai.
Baazigar, Darr and Anjaam make his name with murderous and obsessive anti-heroes, while Kabhi Haan Kabhi Naa introduces the lovable loser.
Dilwale Dulhania Le Jayenge, Pardes, Dil To Pagal Hai and Kuch Kuch Hota Hai make him the defining screen lover of the decade, often opposite Kajol, Madhuri Dixit and Juhi Chawla.
Commercial misses such as Baadshah, Phir Bhi Dil Hai Hindustani and Aśoka alternate with Mohabbatein, Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham, Devdas and Kal Ho Naa Ho; he becomes a producer with Dreamz Unlimited.

Main Hoon Na, Veer-Zaara, Swades, Chak De! India, Om Shanti Om and Rab Ne Bana Di Jodi mix sacrificial romance with patriotic and self-referential star vehicles under his new Red Chillies Entertainment.
My Name Is Khan, Ra.One, Don 2, Jab Tak Hai Jaan, Chennai Express and Happy New Year make romance one strand among action, heist and comedy formats.
Dilwale, Fan, Dear Zindagi, Raees, Jab Harry Met Sejal and Zero meet mixed results; after Zero he appears only in narration and cameos until 2023.
Pathaan, Jawan and Dunki return him to box-office dominance as an older action and dramatic lead, with romance minor or tragic; King is scheduled for December 2026.
